definitions.explanation: Refers to an unspecified small number of countable things — typically more than two but not many. Functions as a noun-like quantity expression and can stand on its own or modify a noun with の.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いくつか⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
いくつか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: I looked around at several shops.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、いくつか⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several points we need to consider regarding this problem.

notes:
Made of いくつ (how many) + the indefinite particle ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧. Used only for countable items; for amounts use ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ or ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いくつか⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are several
- いくつか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: several (of)
- いくつか⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: list a few
- いくつか⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: introduce a few

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いくら⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: somewhat; a little — used for uncountable amounts and degree
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧: a little; a few — vaguer, can modify both count and amount
- ⟦{何|なん}{個|こ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: a few items — more concrete, suggests a specific small number
